screenshots.shows: The fresh candidate is current at 0.5.42, with healthy system status behind the dialog.

The pre-update Runtime page shows one user profile and one working memory. The viewport clips the card list. Both canaries were verified in the browser DOM and in their three Runtime files before the update.
The version dialog offers 0.5.42 to the running 0.5.41.
The dialog shows 0.5.42 installed and waiting for a restart.
The reopened Host shows a healthy 0.5.42 and a current package version.
The reopened Runtime list shows both complete synthetic canaries.

observations: CUA exposed Chrome for this run. Both fresh and restarted tabs reported three browser-extension-origin console errors and zero application-origin errors.
The fresh and restarted status screenshots open the version dialog to show the exact package version, which truncates in the background status tile at the native viewport width.
limitations: Acceptance covers official published Host packages on macOS Web profiles.
Runtime canaries are synthetic and were entered manually in the UI. No model requests or external Provider accounts were used.
The disposable registry ages selected candidate metadata. The npm minimum-release-age policy is outside this acceptance.
This run verifies frozen pre-publication candidates. The release workflow separately verifies final merged artifacts and the public npm install and upgrade.
